about: Strike position on a keyboard strip: inputs and the outputs both ports must give (StrikeMath.kt, ios/FMutateStrikeMath.swift). Read by android/app/src/test/.../StrikeMathTest.kt and ios/Tests. front: 1 at the key's front edge (bottom), 0 at its back edge (top). Fronts are exact binary fractions, so Float (Kotlin) and Double (Swift) agree; x.5 results check that both round half up.

velocity.case: top (back edge) of a default strip

strikeLevel.case: top of a default strip: about 16.5 dB down
middle of a default strip: about 8 dB down

heldLevel.case: slid halfway to the back edge
slid further toward the front edge
at the front edge: full level
struck at the front edge, held there
struck at the front edge, slid to the middle (63.5 rounds up)
struck at the back edge, held there
struck at the back edge, slid to the middle (94.5 rounds up)
struck at the back edge, slid to the front edge
struck in the middle, slid forward
struck in the middle, slid back
